data.code_commit_message:
fix(cpu): SIM-BUG-16 — 0-gap RAW hazard stall detection

Add detectZeroGapHazard() that checks if the instruction about to be
decoded reads a register that the instruction entering EX will write.
Inserts a 1-cycle stall so the producer reaches exec_to_mem where
existing forwarding picks it up. Matches hardware stall unit behavior.

Fixes test_sort producing wrong results when AND R5,R0 immediately
precedes LW R6,0(R5) with no NOP gap.
